name: Linux x86_64 compatibility runtime
description: glibc and the exact amd64 dependency closure for the translated x86_64 binutils proof.
license: Upstream licenses included in usr/share/doc/*/copyright (GPL, LGPL, BSD, MIT and others)
notes: Native host linux-arm64, foreign architecture amd64. QEMU_LD_PREFIX=/opt/gizmoth/x86_64 is supplied by GizMoth when translating x86_64 processes. Library layers share the prefix but each recipe has only one extraction destination. No global PATH changes.
